cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial screen layout renders correctly
cases.steps:
1. From the main menu, select the Account View (DB2) function (transaction OD01).
2. Observe the screen before entering anything.
cases.expected: The Account View (DB2) screen opens (24 rows × 80 columns): a header line shows 「Tran:」, the screen title and 「Date:」; the second line shows 「Pgm :」 and 「Time:」; the green entry field for 「Account ID:」 sits at line 6; the display-only labels 「Status」「Curr Bal」「Credit Lim」「Cash Lim」「Open Date」「Expiry」「Group ID」 run down the left; a red message line sits near the bottom; the cursor rests in the Account ID field.
cases.remark: UI §2.1 MACCTVA; mapset MACCTV; 1000-SEND-INITIAL, SEND MAP('MACCTVA') ERASE L62; ACCTID POS=(06,17) LEN=11 IC.

cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Bottom-line function-key legend is shown
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Read the caption on the bottom line.
cases.expected: The bottom line shows the key legend 「ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear」 exactly as worded.
cases.remark: MACCTV.bms POS=(24,01) LEN=34 INITIAL='ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear'.

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: Initial state — blank detail area and entry prompt
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01) for the first time.
2. Observe the message line, the detail fields and the header fields.
cases.expected: The Account ID field is empty and all detail fields (Status, Curr Bal, Credit Lim, Cash Lim, Open Date, Expiry, Group ID) are blank; the message line shows 「Enter account id and press ENTER.」; the header shows Tran 「OD01」, Pgm 「ODACCTV」, title 「ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM」 and the current system date and time (e.g. 2026-09-28).
cases.remark: 1000-SEND-INITIAL L53-63: MOVE LOW-VALUES TO MACCTVAO; MSG1 L55; 8000-POPULATE-HEADER; 8500-GET-DATE-TIME (ASKTIME/FORMATTIME); WS-HDR-TITLE (WHEAD).

cases.mid: 表示条件・活性制御 (Display conditions / enable control)
cases.name: Only Account ID is enterable; all detail fields are display-only
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Try to type into the Account ID field, then try to type into the Status / Curr Bal / Group ID fields.
3. Look up account 00000000001 and observe the fields again.
cases.expected: Only the Account ID field accepts input (green, unprotected); the Status, Curr Bal, Credit Lim, Cash Lim, Open Date, Expiry and Group ID fields never accept input — they stay display-only both before and after a record is shown.
cases.remark: §2 item states; MACCTV.bms — ACCTID ATTRB=(UNPROT,IC,FSET); all detail fields ATTRB=(ASKIP,NORM).

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Amounts, status and dates are formatted for display
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Enter Account ID = 00000000002 and press ENTER.
3. Check how the amounts, status and dates are shown.
cases.expected: Money fields are shown right-aligned with comma grouping and two decimals — Curr Bal 「2,500.75」, Credit Lim 「10,000.00」, Cash Lim 「2,000.00」; Status shows the single character 「Y」; dates show as 「2020-07-01」 (Open) and 「2028-06-30」 (Expiry); Group ID shows 「PLATINUM」.
cases.remark: 4000-POPULATE-DETAIL; WS-ED-BAL/WS-ED-AMT PIC -,---,---,--9.99 (WCONST); AC-ACTIVE-STATUS X(01); dates X(10); account 00000000002 seed.

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: View an active account by its key (main flow)
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Enter Account ID = 00000000001.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The account is read from the DB2 account master and its details are shown: Status 「Y」, Curr Bal 「1,234.56」, Credit Lim 「5,000.00」, Cash Lim 「1,000.00」, Open Date 「2019-03-15」, Expiry 「2027-03-31」, Group ID 「GOLD」; the message line shows 「Account displayed.」.
cases.remark: 2100-READ-AND-SHOW → 3000-READ-ACCT (EXEC SQL SELECT FROM ORION.ACCT WHERE AC_ID) SQLCODE 0 → REC-FOUND; 4000-POPULATE-DETAIL; MSG2 L96; account 1 seed.

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: View an inactive account — status N is still fully displayed
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Enter Account ID = 00000000003.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The inactive account is shown in full — there is no active-status gate: Status 「N」, Curr Bal 「0.00」, Credit Lim 「3,000.00」, Cash Lim 「500.00」, Open Date 「2018-01-20」, Expiry 「2026-01-31」, Group ID 「STANDARD」; the message line shows 「Account displayed.」.
cases.remark: Content variant status=N; program has no status check in 2100/4000; account 3 seed (bal 0.00).

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: View a high-balance PLATINUM account
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Enter Account ID = 00000000004.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The account is shown: Status 「Y」, Curr Bal 「15,000.00」, Credit Lim 「25,000.00」, Cash Lim 「5,000.00」, Open Date 「2021-11-11」, Expiry 「2029-11-30」, Group ID 「PLATINUM」; the message line shows 「Account displayed.」. Large amounts render with two comma groups.
cases.remark: Content variant (large amounts, PLATINUM); account 4 seed; WS-ED-AMT comma grouping.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF3 returns to the main menu
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Press PF3.
cases.expected: The screen is abandoned and control transfers to the main menu; no account lookup is performed.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF3 → 7000-XCTL-MENU; EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(WS-MENU-PGM=OCMENU) L161; CA-PGM-CONTEXT reset 0.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the entry and re-prompts
cases.precondition: F-STD; account 00000000001 has just been displayed.
cases.steps: 1. With account 00000000001 shown, press PF4.
cases.expected: The screen is cleared — the Account ID field and all detail fields are blank again and the message line shows 「Enter account id and press ENTER.」, ready for a fresh key.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF4 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL (MOVE LOW-VALUES TO MACCTVAO; MSG1; SEND ERASE).

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: Pressing an unsupported key is rejected
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Press an unsupported key, e.g. PF9.
cases.expected: The entry is not processed; the screen is redisplayed with the detail area cleared and the message line shows 「Invalid key pressed. Please try again.」.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN OTHER L73-76: 1000-SEND-INITIAL then MOVE WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY (WMSG) L75; 8100-SEND-DATAONLY.

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Re-query a different account without leaving the screen
cases.steps:
1. With account 00000000001 shown, overtype the Account ID field with 00000000002.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The screen stays on the Account View (DB2) screen (pseudo-conversational) and refreshes to account 00000000002 — Status 「Y」, Curr Bal 「2,500.75」, Group ID 「PLATINUM」; the message line shows 「Account displayed.」.
cases.remark: 0000-MAIN EIBCALEN>0 + CA-PGM-CONTEXT=1 (not CA-FIRST-ENTER) → 2000-PROCESS-INPUT; RETURN TRANSID(OD01) L200 keeps the conversation; account 2 seed.

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Cold start — entering the transaction directly shows the initial screen
cases.steps: 1. At a clear CICS screen, type the transaction id OD01 and press ENTER.
cases.expected: The initial Account View (DB2) screen is shown with an empty Account ID field and the message line 「Enter account id and press ENTER.」 — the same as a fresh entry from the menu.
cases.remark: 0000-MAIN: IF EIBCALEN = 0 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL (cold-start branch, no commarea).

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Blank Account ID is rejected as required
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Leave the Account ID field empty.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: No lookup is attempted; the message line shows 「Please enter all required fields.」 and the screen waits for a key.
cases.remark: 2100 IF ACCTIDI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES → MOVE WS-MSG-REQUIRED (WMSG) L87; 8100-SEND-DATAONLY.

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Non-numeric Account ID is rejected
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Enter Account ID = 1234ABCD901.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: No lookup is attempted; the message line shows 「Account id must be numeric.」.
cases.remark: 2100 ELSE (not blank) → IF ACCTIDI IS NUMERIC false → ELSE MOVE 'Account id must be numeric.' L103; 8100-SEND-DATAONLY.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Account key not present in the table
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Enter Account ID = 00000000010.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The lookup returns no row; the detail area stays blank and the message line shows 「Record not found.」.
cases.remark: 3000-READ-ACCT SQLCODE 100 → REC-NOT-FOUND; 2100 ELSE MOVE WS-MSG-NOTFND (WMSG) L99; 8100-SEND-DATAONLY.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: DB2 read failure surfaces as 「Record not found.」 (read-error text is dead)
cases.precondition: F-STD; the DB2 read on the account table fails at runtime (e.g. resource unavailable / timeout) so a non-zero, non-100 SQL result is returned. *(needs real data — env-simulated)*
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Enter Account ID = 00000000001 while the account table read is failing.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The operator sees 「Record not found.」 on the message line. The internal 「Error reading account table.」 text is set but immediately overwritten by the not-found message before the screen is sent, so it is never displayed (dead path — documented, not a defect to fix here).
cases.remark: 3000 SQLCODE OTHER L135-137 sets REC-NOT-FOUND + MOVE 'Error reading account table.'; 2100 ELSE overwrites with WS-MSG-NOTFND L99 → MSG4 DEAD. See NOTES §Dead-code exclusion.

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Full 11-digit zero-padded key is accepted (max field width)
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Enter the fully filled 11-digit key 00000000005.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The key fills the whole field and is numeric, so the lookup succeeds: Status 「Y」, Curr Bal 「99.99」, Credit Lim 「7,500.00」, Group ID 「GOLD」; the message line shows 「Account displayed.」.
cases.remark: ACCTID field width 11 (LEN=11); AC-ID PIC 9(11); IS NUMERIC over full field passes; account 5 seed (min non-zero bal 99.99).

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Partial key (fewer than 11 digits) fails the numeric check
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Type a single digit 5 into the Account ID field (leaving the rest blank).
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: Because the unfilled positions are blank, the field is not all-numeric, so no lookup is done and the message line shows 「Account id must be numeric.」. A successful lookup requires the full 11-digit zero-padded key (e.g. 00000000005).
cases.remark: IS NUMERIC tests the whole X(11) ACCTIDI; partial entry has trailing blanks/nulls → false → 'Account id must be numeric.' L103. MSG3 second trigger (full-width requirement).

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: All-zeros key (numeric value 0) is accepted but not found
cases.steps:
1. Open the Account View (DB2) screen (transaction OD01).
2. Enter Account ID = 00000000000.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The field is all-numeric so the numeric check passes and a lookup is attempted for key 0; no such row exists, so the message line shows 「Record not found.」.
cases.remark: Numeric value lower edge (0): passes IS NUMERIC; 3000 SQLCODE 100 → WS-MSG-NOTFND. Distinguishes numeric-format-OK from key-exists.
